snippet.title: Verse Project - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Verse Project is a multiplayer space simulator developed by indie game studio Synthes Games. Explore the Solar System at real world scale without loading screens.

Try for free while playtest or demo. Add to your Wishlist not to miss Early Access or Release Date. 

Website - https://verseproject.online
